note: Hand-written support tickets for Writing a prompt (R6): the customers and businesses are made up, their addresses are .example, and each note is a line of Larkspur policy from data/corpus/.

tickets.text: The Portal has been down since 9 p.m. and our night shift can't print pick lists. Who do we contact right now?
tickets.note: For Portal outages outside business hours, page the on-call engineer through the Duty Desk line at extension 4410. The engineer acknowledges a page within 15 minutes.

tickets.text: We're on an enterprise contract and want a refund for 40 scanners we no longer need. How do we get it?
tickets.note: The refund policy does not apply to enterprise contracts. Enterprise customers raise a billing dispute with their account manager, who answers in writing within ten business days.

tickets.text: If I order three in-stock label printers at 1 p.m. Central today, will they ship today?
tickets.note: Orders for in-stock items placed before 2 p.m. Central time on a business day ship the same day; later orders ship the next business day.

tickets.text: Do we pay for parcel shipping on a $620 order of label printers?
tickets.note: Parcel shipping is free on orders over $500.

tickets.text: One of our DS-100 dock door sensors stopped working 26 months after it shipped. Is it still covered?
tickets.note: The DS-100 dock door sensor is warranted against defects for three years from the date of shipment.

tickets.text: Two of the printers we got yesterday have cracked cases. What do we do?
tickets.note: Report damage within five days of delivery with photos of the carton and the item. Replacements ship once the carrier claim is opened.

examples.ticket: How do I reorder something we bought last month?
examples.reply: Open Order history in the Portal and choose Reorder on that order. If anything is out of stock, the Portal shows a new date for that line.

examples.ticket: Can we pay this invoice by bank transfer?
examples.reply: Yes, bank transfer works for invoices over $2,000. The bank details are printed on the invoice itself.

generic: Thanks for getting in touch, and sorry for the trouble. We're looking into it and will get back to you soon.
